title: 9. Sobre a impossibilidade de dominar o "sexo frágil"

queries.text: "colocar chifres" (to give someone horns) is the Portuguese idiom for cuckolding; kept the image ("a fine pair of horns"), which exists in older English. Alternative: "will cheat on us in style".

The Prince, ch. 25, translated from the author's Portuguese. Public-domain English (W. K. Marriott, 1908): "fortune is a woman, and if you wish to keep her under it is necessary to beat and ill-use her".

Thus Spoke Zarathustra, "Of Old and Young Women," translated from the author's Portuguese. Public-domain English: Thomas Common's translation. "Super-homem" rendered "superman" (Common's term; "overman" is the modern alternative). The author's emphasis ("grifo meu") is not marked in the extracted text.
The Portuguese slang is "cozinhar" (lit. "to cook"), meaning to keep someone waiting/stall them. Rendered "letting him stew". Alternatives: "stringing him along", "running out the clock".
